analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI is consolidating in the neutral zone around the 60-level. MACD histogram has turned from positive to negative, entering a worsening phase. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 1.22, indicating normal levels. Current price $2,452.61 is below the swing resistance at $2,462.8. Due to lack of further upward momentum and MACD worsening signals, initiating a buy is deemed premature.
